input.args: {{ steps.prepare-specification-request.output.specification_args }} Return actual_spec_dir and the authoring report. Honor the explicit SPECIFY_FEATURE_DIRECTORY and preserve .specify/feature.json identity; do not invoke another workflow.

steps.prompt: Inspect the created specification at {{ steps.draft-specification.output.actual_spec_dir }} and .specify/feature.json feature_directory, then compare them with every roadmap Spec dir mapping. Use exact selected_entry_id {{ steps.inspect-active-feature.output.selected_entry_id }} and never infer identity from feature number alone. Return one structured result with state (linked, repairable, or blocked), selected_entry_id, actual_spec_dir, and evidence. Format actual_spec_dir as a repository-relative directory ending in slash. Use linked only when that one entry has exactly one exact mapping to this directory and no other entry claims the same directory. Use repairable only when the selected entry is uniquely identified and its Spec dir is missing or stale, no other entry claims the actual directory, and you can present a minimal exact patch to that row as proposed_patch. Write the patch as the exact Markdown row with the path inside backticks and no trailing punctuation inside the backticks. Return blocked with the exact cause and recovery action for conflicting ownership, ambiguous identity, or required operator input. Do not edit the roadmap. Require the observed directory to equal the active target {{ steps.inspect-active-feature.output.actual_spec_dir }}; return blocked for unexpected target creation or pointer drift, never authorize a roadmap patch to legitimize a new target.

input.args: Apply only this exact Spec dir patch, which was explicitly approved at review-spec-dir-patch, for roadmap entry {{ steps.assess-created-spec-linkage.output.selected_entry_id }} and actual directory {{ steps.assess-created-spec-linkage.output.actual_spec_dir }}: {{ steps.assess-created-spec-linkage.output.proposed_patch }}. Do not infer the target from its feature number or broaden the patch.

approve-exact-patch.prompt: Re-read the roadmap after the approved write and re-check .specify/feature.json plus the actual created spec directory. Return a structured result with state and fresh evidence. Return state linked only if selected_entry_id {{ steps.assess-created-spec-linkage.output.selected_entry_id }} is the unique exact owner of actual_spec_dir {{ steps.assess-created-spec-linkage.output.actual_spec_dir }}. The directory and pointer must also still equal the original active target {{ steps.inspect-active-feature.output.actual_spec_dir }}; otherwise return blocked. For any failed verification return blocked with the exact cause and recovery action; do not propose another repair in this invocation. Do not edit the roadmap.
